messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
satvik madaan

satvik madaan... solid name. sounds like someone who's got their life figured out but probably doesn't.

where you working these days?
moengage

moengage... the marketing automation platform that's probably sending you push notifications right now. found you on linkedin - satvik madaan, software@moengage. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/satvik0125
yeah

software at moengage... building the engagement platform that makes everyone's phone buzz at 3am with "you left something in your cart" messages. the irony of working at a company that professionally annoys people is beautiful.

what made you pick the software engineering route? always been a code person or did life just happen that way?
been a code person
2.5 years

makes sense. once you taste the power of making machines do exactly what you want, everything else feels like begging people to cooperate.

how long you been working total?

2.5 years... you're past the "i have no idea what i'm doing" phase but not quite at the "i'm too senior for this startup nonsense" stage. perfect timing actually.

what kind of role you looking for next?
mostly software but specifically sde2

sde2... making the classic jump from "fix bugs and implement features someone else designed" to "actually have opinions about architecture." smart move at 2.5 years - you're hitting that sweet spot where you know enough to be dangerous.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

open to gurgaon mumbai and blr
  remote as well
2.5 years + sde2 + blr/gurgaon/mumbai/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
yeah

legend! you're officially in the tal ecosystem now. 

your profile is locked and loaded - 2.5 years, sde2 hunting across blr/gurgaon/mumbai + remote. the algorithm's already plotting your next move.

roles that actually match your vibe will start sliding into this chat. no spam, no random "urgent openings" - just opportunities that make sense for where you're at.

welcome to the fam, satvik. time to level up that career 🔥
Hi

JAVA Developer at Virtusa

Satvik, your Java/Spring skills & Gurgaon location preference align well, though experience is a slight stretch.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/BMcyj

Custom Software Engineer at Accenture services Pvt Ltd

Satvik, this Mumbai-based Java Full Stack role aligns with your SDE2 goals and experience.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/Nzut4

Custom Software Engineer at Accenture services Pvt Ltd

Satvik, your Java full-stack skills & Mumbai location preference align well with this SDE role.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/Ceofq

hey, accenture has a custom software engineer role in mumbai

it's a 3+ years requirement but you're close enough at 2.5

mostly react/frontend focused though - that work for you?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

bain & company has a software engineer role in gurgaon

it's a tier 1 brand upgrade from moengage, which is solid for your resume

mostly .net/azure stack though - you open to that?

techahead has a devops engineer role in noida

experience requirement is 2+ years which matches your 2.5 pretty well

but it's a full devops/aws role - you have infrastructure experience?

uplers has a fullstack dev role that's fully remote

working for a california AI company, typescript/react/fastapi stack

it's a 12-month contract though - you open to that?

sproutsAI has a senior software engineer role in chennai

it's a silicon valley AI startup doing LLMs/RAG stuff - pretty cutting edge

says 3+ years experience, you're at 2.5 so it's a stretch but could be worth it
